label: Votive Mass of the Holy Spirit — De Spiritu Sancto

chants.notes: Extra tempus Quadragesimae (primary Introit of this seasonal form; distinct from the 'Tempore Quadragesimae' Introit Dum sanctificatus fuero, target 249, below).
Extra tempus Quadragesimae. Bare em-dash alternate Introit.

Extra tempus Quadragesimae. Gradual is invariant between the two seasonal forms of this Mass -- the identical citation 'GR. Beata gens, 333.' is printed again under 'Tempore Quadragesimae' on p661 (see the other 'gr' row below); both are real printed citations, kept as two rows even though they resolve to the same chant_uuid.

Extra tempus Quadragesimae. Printed 'AL. Emitte Spiritum tuum, 249, vel 253.' -- one incipit cited at two alternate pages, both carrying a chant of this title (p249's index entry is annotated '(altera melodia)'). Modeled as two AL rows sharing the same incipit with different target_page, per the precedent in in-conferenda-confirmatione.json.
Extra tempus Quadragesimae. Second target page of the 'vel 253' dual-target citation (see the primary AL row above).

Extra tempus Quadragesimae. Bare em-dash alternate Alleluia, a different chant from the 'Emitte Spiritum tuum' pair above despite sharing target_page 253 (confirmed via gr_index_entry: 253 carries both an alleluia 'Emitte Spiritum tuum' mode 4 and an alleluia 'Veni, Sancte Spiritus' mode 2).

Extra tempus Quadragesimae. Resolves to the CUM-Alleluia engraving (gregobase 361), the only Confirma hoc the GR prints -- p255 ends 'offerent reges munera, alleluia.' The earlier note here flagged that this target page's index row (gr_index_entry row 1495) was match_status='reviewed' rather than 'resolved'; that suspicion was correct -- the hand-curated row pointed at the sine-Alleluia form (gregobase 83), which the GR never prints. Fixed 2026-09-26. Alleluia suppression outside Paschaltide is global logic's job, not a different chant.

Extra tempus Quadragesimae. Bare em-dash alternate Offertory -- a DIFFERENT chant from the Alleluia 'Emitte Spiritum tuum' rows above despite the identical incipit (confirmed via gr_index_entry: p250 offertorium 'Emitte Spiritum tuum' mode 8, distinct row/chant from the p249/253 alleluia entries).
Extra tempus Quadragesimae. Bare em-dash alternate Communion.

Tempore Quadragesimae. Shares a printed block/line with the GR citation below ('IN. Dum sanctificatus fuero in vobis, 249. GR. Beata gens, 333.'), hence the shared band. Cites the SAME target page (249) as the 'Extra tempus' Alleluia 'Emitte Spiritum tuum' above, but is a different chant (confirmed via gr_index_entry: p249 carries both an introitus 'Dum sanctificatus fuero' mode 3 and an alleluia 'Emitte Spiritum tuum (altera melodia)' mode 2).

Tempore Quadragesimae. Same Gradual citation as the 'Extra tempus Quadragesimae' GR row above (the Gradual does not change between the two seasonal forms); shares a printed block/line with the IN citation above.

Tempore Quadragesimae. Engraved Tract, labelled 'TR. II' above drop-cap 'E' -- confirmed by vision and by gr_index_entry (page=661, tractus, mode=2, incipit='Emitte Spiritum tuum', gregobase_id=925) that 'II' is the MODE, not an option/citation marker, matching the 'PART. mode' convention elsewhere (pro-sponsis.json, de-sacratissimo-corde-iesu.json). Engraving continues onto p662 ('...ignem accende.'); band confined to p661 per bbox-sanity-check convention, tail on p662 not captured.
